## The creator

Controls bind to appearance keys, and min/max is read from the driver at runtime,
so adding one is a single line in a step of `Config.Creator`:

```lua
{ type = "spinner", key = "mask_1", label = "MASK", half = true },
```

`half = true` puts it in a two-column row, and
`camera = "head" | "torso" | "feet" | "wrist"` frames that shot while the control
is in use — that is how SHOES and WATCH work. The step and control field lists are
in **[Config reference § 14](../config/scene/)**.

**Every value is a number.** Pickers are labelled `STYLE 1`, `STYLE 2` and so on,
with no names and no option to add them, because **clicking the value turns it into
a box you type a style number into** — the only workable way to reach style 247 of
300, and to get back to it tomorrow. It also cannot go stale: drawable numbers move
when you stream an add-on hair or clothing pack, so a name after the insert point
would describe a different garment.

Colour swatches work the same way; `Config.EyeColors` gives each index a hex, which
paints the dot. Tattoo zones are numbered from the order of `Config.Tattoos`, with
`0` meaning bare skin.
